adoption.notes: The runtime signs the unchanged command bytes and never reissues a command: egress publishes once, held by tests on its call sites, its scheduling and its client. It reads rate_limited only as a firmware-telemetry/v2 fault. It drives no firmware-commanded zone, so the Tier D attempt carve-out has no runtime path yet. No conformance claim is made, so the version is not frozen by this merge.

notes: Exists for the rate_limited verdict, which answers relay_close only, and for the rule that a runtime never reissues a command to recover its delivery. Fresh open_protected_circuit attempts for a latched Tier D trip are not reissues and continue, under the binding the governing safety-profile contract authorizes. Command, provisioning approval and liveness bytes are v1's and keep v 1. The runtime has adopted it; the edge firmware has not. The runtime adopts it before any device signs a v 2 fault.
